{{Quote|Hey. What are you up to?|Trooper to Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] enlisted member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed at [[Mulvar Sensor Station]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''Although [[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]], the novel contains numerous flashbacks set in earlier years, including [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the enlisted trooper was carrying a tray of [[Caf/Legends|caf]] to Tower Three when he encountered [[Voort saBinring]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], who was disguised as a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] maintenance worker. After asking saBinring what he was doing, the trooper was struck by [[Shalla Nelprin]], another Wraith commando, and rendered unconscious. He was then carried by Wraith [[Hohass Ekwesh]] and placed beside an unconscious [[Unidentified Tower Three guard|guard]] that saBinring [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] earlier with a compact [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The Wraiths subsequently continued their [[Raid on Mulvar sensor station|operation]] to destroy the station.<ref name="MK" />
